original_A_records.later_acceptance: Deliver>=17.3205080757Vrms plus margin; no battery supplement

original_A_records.label: current margin
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Deliver>=1A peak while normal cap<=1.04A; independent protection min>=1.04 and max<=1.08A source conditional

original_A_records.label: power rails
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Select exact converter/inductor/FET/diode/feedback/compensation/enable/discharge topology; positive regulation/source current margins

original_A_records.label: source allocation
original_A_records.domain: valid20V5A PD, input>=19V, charge/speakers off; other16W+reserve4W
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Source available>=75.24W; converters efficiency>=.85; other loads<=16W; reconcile integrated worst concurrency

original_A_records.label: IV circuit
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Complete exact passives MPNs; solve coupled IV/common-mode loop and hot loading, current, noise and finite calibrated raw range

original_A_records.label: amplifier compensation
original_A_records.domain: all admitted resistive/complex loads and hardware limits
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Source-compatible compensation; phase margin>=60deg, gain margin>=10dB; no unexplained model anomaly; complete-chain20Hz..20kHz+/-0.1dB proposal preserved

original_A_records.label: normal SOA
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Entire current-voltage trajectory below Fig40TC85 boundary, not just peak watts; arbitrary shorts are safety cutset domain

original_A_records.label: independent fault clearing
original_A_records.domain: short, rail, DC, thermal, unplug/mode, MCU crash
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Receive exact source-qualified output isolator/control/current/SOA/rail/DC/temperature mechanisms from safety; no typical OPA548 limit or thermal delay as authority

original_A_records.label: default enables
original_A_records.domain: boot, source loss, blank firmware, rails absent
original_A_records.later_acceptance: POWER_ES<=VEE+.8 disable; >=VEE+2.4 enable; exact negative-rail referenced failclosed driver; QUIET_ENABLE<=.65 off / >=.95 on within active local positive rail

original_A_records.label: quiet IEM
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Measured amplitude/current/complex load stable; protect inserted IEM and respect <=50mApeak

original_A_records.label: quiet noise
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Actual integrated noise<=1uVrms incl all supplies/USB/radio/clock/source modes; no typical-noise sum as proof

original_A_records.label: output impedance
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Total amplifier/series/shunt/contact/interconnect differential impedance <= target; stable feedback retained before output disconnect

original_A_records.label: low level matching
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Calibrated matching<=.1dB including all analog ratios and measured DAC gain; no 1uV noise guarantee from ratio screen

original_A_records.label: line level
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Separate connector/conductor routing or exact source-qualified mode/load interlock; no automatic fixed line to IEM

original_A_records.label: output routing
original_A_records.domain: 4 BAL and2SE conductors + line outputs; only one output mode active
original_A_records.later_acceptance: Exact switches and hardware one-hot break-before-make; never ground balanced negative leg; source insertion/rearm controls failclosed

original_A_records.label: stereo speakers

original_A_records.later_acceptance: Exact speaker MPN/driver/supply/default/mute/rates and source approved protocol route; not merely TPA2016D2 symbol

original_A_records.label: thermal realization
